notes: Input is the LLNL author manuscript (UCRL-JRNL-227848, dated February 7, 2007) of the Chemistry of Materials communication, not the publisher's typeset version. The supporting information (Figure 1S, 77 K isotherms for the Ni- and Co-modified CAs) is not in the input; the main text alone meets I1-I5. The 330 m2/g sample is an uncarbonized organic aerogel (p. 3, Figure 1 caption: 'was not carbonized') and is not a carbon sorbent under protocol section 3; the CO2-activated carbon aerogels (1460-3200 m2/g BET) and the Co- and Ni-doped carbon aerogels are. 'Full synthetic details and structural characterization of the ACAs will be presented elsewhere' (p. 3) points to a later publication, not an earlier source of the values, so duplicate_data does not apply.
